title: Tiffin Tracker Update
message: Major update with Firebase Cloud Firestore real-time sync and native background poll notifications!
releaseNotes: Firebase Cloud Firestore real-time database integration
Native background notifications for meal polls (even when app is killed)
Automatic 5-minute reminder alarms until votes are cast
Creator exemption: Poll creator is redirected without reminder alerts
Clean deduplication for multi-device login (app vs web)
